svg.aria-label: libpcache animation. Put: the page key goes into a SQLite index row and the page bytes into a fixed-size slot of the data file. Get: the key is looked up in the index and the page is copied back. FIFO: the volume always keeps one slot free; each write fills it and evicts the oldest page in the next slot.
svg.title: libpcache: how a volume stores pages

g.text: look up id in the index
pcache_put_page(h, id, write_buf) key → index, bytes → slot
pcache_get_page(h, id, read_buf) find id in index, read its slot
more puts fill the free slots
last free slot written → oldest page evicted in the same step
steady state: each put fills the free slot, evicts the next
two files, one volume · thread-safe · every operation atomic
